research_rationale:
EO 12468 (Presidential Advisory Council on the Peace Corps), signed 1984-03-22. The order establishes the Presidential Advisory Council on the Peace Corps (Section 1), its advisory and annual-report functions (Section 2), administration (Section 3) and general provisions (Section 4). Section 4(b) provides that the Council terminates two years from the date of the order, unless sooner extended, that is 1986-03-22, which is later than the revocation. First end: Section 3(o) of EO 12534 (Continuance of Certain Federal Advisory Committees, signed 1985-09-30, 50 FR 40319-40320) names Executive Order No. 12468 among the orders revoked, and Section 5 makes that order effective September 30, 1985, so the revocation took effect on 1985-09-30. The list in Section 3 names the order as a whole ("Executive Order No. 12468, establishing the Presidential Advisory Council"), so this is a whole-order revocation and not a partial one. The lead-in describes the listed orders as ones that established committees which have terminated or been abolished by statute or whose work is completed; that recital is disclosed as context and as a possible earlier cessation, but it gives no date and is not an end.
